title: A graph placement methodology for fast chip design
summary: A reinforcement-learning agent generated chip floorplans in under six hours that the authors report as superior or comparable to human-produced layouts in power, performance and area.
ai_technology: Deep reinforcement learning with edge-based graph convolutional network

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Comparison with human layouts reported in abstract.
evidence.unknown: Engineering result, not a scientific discovery in the narrow sense; independent reproduction and later critiques not assessed.
